title: Derivative of Gaussian bivariate stability
statement:
Let $\rho\in(-1,1)$ and $a,b\in(0,1)$. As a function of its second threshold, the Gaussian bivariate stability at thresholds $a$ and $b$ has derivative at $b$ equal to
\[
\Phi\!\left(\frac{Q(a)-\rho Q(b)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}\right),
\]
where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function and $Q$ is its lower quantile.
